acip: SA BON DE LAS GZHAN PA'I BAG CHAGS KYI SGRIB PA SHES SGRIB TU 'JOG PA NI, SA BRGYAD PA MA THOB BAR DU SPONG BA MIN PA'I PHYIR RO,,
wylie: sa bon de las gzhan pa'i bag chags kyi sgrib pa shes sgrib tu 'jog pa ni, sa brgyad pa ma thob bar du spong ba min pa'i phyir ro
english: This is because we say that obstacles represented by mental potentials other than these particular seeds are obstacles to omniscience because they are not eliminated until we attain the eighth level.
